comment: Curated content for the Outpost catalog. Zim refs are 'name' or 'name:flavour' as in the Kiwix library. build.py resolves each to the newest file, its exact size and SHA-256.

models.description: Gave the most accurate answers to emergency questions in Outpost's tests. Recommended for most computers.

subjects.wikipedia: General knowledge on almost anything: history, places, people, plants, machines, diseases. When you need background on a subject the other collections do not cover, this is where you start.
subjects.medicine: What to do when someone is hurt or ill and no doctor or pharmacist can be reached: first aid, field and military medicine, how drugs work and what doses mean, and the reasoning behind treatment.
subjects.survival: Keeping people alive and supplied when services stop: clean water, food that keeps, knots and shelter, and the practical engineering of rebuilding after a disaster.
subjects.repair: Keeping what you own working when you cannot buy a replacement or call a technician: step-by-step repair guides and answers from people who fix houses, vehicles, bicycles and electronics.
subjects.homestead: Growing, cooking, preserving and brewing food, and caring for animals, with recipes and answers from experienced gardeners and cooks.
subjects.education: Teaching children and adults without a school or an internet connection: courses, textbooks, lessons and exercises from primary school to university level.
subjects.science: The underlying science and mathematics: reference articles and expert answers in physics, chemistry, biology, earth science and maths.
subjects.computing: Keeping computers, Linux systems and small boards like the Raspberry Pi running, and learning to program, with no online help to search.
subjects.reference: Word meanings, spelling and translations, quotations, travel information on places, and the full text of public-domain source documents.
subjects.books: A library of free public-domain books: literature for morale and schooling, and old practical manuals on farming, technology, medicine and science.
subjects.maps: Street-level maps you can read with no signal: roads, paths, buildings, place names, water and terrain features for navigation and planning.
subjects.models: An optional AI assistant that runs on your own machine and answers questions using the library, for when you do not know which article to look in.

items.wikipedia_en_top_mini: The introductions of Wikipedia's 50,000 most-read articles: a quick reference that fits on almost any device.
items.wikipedia_en_top_maxi: Wikipedia's 50,000 most-read articles in full, with pictures: the most useful part of the encyclopedia at a small fraction of its size.
items.wikipedia_en_top1m_nopic: The million most important Wikipedia articles in full text: broad coverage on a modest drive, without pictures.
items.wikipedia_en_all_mini: Every English Wikipedia article, introduction only: the whole range of topics when space is tight.
items.wikipedia_en_all_nopic: Every English Wikipedia article in full, without pictures: the complete text at under half the size.
items.wikipedia_en_all_maxi: All of English Wikipedia as it is on the web, with pictures: the most complete general reference in the library.
items.zimgit-medicine_en: Field and emergency medicine manuals in PDF form: the books written for treating people far from hospitals.
items.irp.fas.org_en_military-medicine: US military medical manuals: trauma care, field surgery and medicine under austere conditions, written for people without a hospital behind them.
items.nhs.uk_en_medicines: The NHS guide to common medicines: what each is for, how and when to take it, side effects and what not to mix it with.
items.wikipedia_en_medicine_maxi: WikiMed, Wikipedia's medical articles with pictures: diseases, injuries, drugs, anatomy and procedures in one place.
items.mdwiki_en_all_maxi: MDWiki, health articles reviewed by WikiProjectMed's doctors: a second medical encyclopedia that is checked for accuracy.
items.libretexts.org_en_med: University-level medicine and nursing textbooks: the background needed to understand a diagnosis or treatment, not just follow it.
items.quickguidesformedicine_en_all: Short teaching videos made for junior doctors: clear explanations of common clinical problems and how to manage them.
items.medicalsciences.stackexchange.com_en_all: Questions about health and medicine answered by people with medical training, with sources.
items.ted_mul_medicine: TED talks on medicine: advances, how treatments work, and lessons from the field.
items.ted_mul_health: TED talks on health: prevention, the body, sleep, food and staying well.
items.ted_mul_public-health: TED talks on public health: epidemics, sanitation, vaccination and keeping communities healthy.
items.ted_mul_mental-health: TED talks on mental health: stress, grief, trauma, anxiety and depression, and how to help someone through them.
items.zimgit-water_en: Manuals on finding, collecting, storing and purifying drinking water: the first thing to get right in any emergency.
items.zimgit-food-preparation_en: Recipes and methods for preparing and preserving food from stored and foraged supplies.
items.zimgit-post-disaster_en: Documents on what to do after a disaster: shelter, sanitation, first aid, rebuilding and organising a community.
items.zimgit-knots_en: Illustrated guides to knots, lashings, ladders and sutures: tying the right knot for loads, rescue, shelter and repair.
items.wikipedia_en_knots_maxi: Wikipedia's articles on individual knots, with diagrams.
items.appropedia_en_all_maxi: Appropedia: practical, low-cost technology for water, energy, food, shelter and health, built from local materials.
items.cd3wdproject.org_en_all: CD3WD: over 900 technical manuals on agriculture, water, building, energy and small industry for places without modern infrastructure.
items.outdoors.stackexchange.com_en_all: Answers on wilderness skills: navigation, camping, fire, weather, wildlife and staying safe outdoors.
items.sustainability.stackexchange.com_en_all: Answers on living with fewer resources: energy, water, waste and self-sufficiency.
items.canadian-prepper_en_preppingfood: Videos on long-term food storage and survival meals: what to store, how to store it and how to cook it.
items.energypedia_en_all_maxi: energypedia: solar, wind, hydro, biomass and cooking stoves, and how to set up power where there is no grid.
items.ted_mul_water: TED talks on water: scarcity, cleaning and getting it to people who have none.
items.ifixit_en_all: iFixit's step-by-step repair guides with photos for thousands of devices: phones, computers, appliances, tools and vehicles.
items.diy.stackexchange.com_en_all: Answers from contractors and experienced DIYers on wiring, plumbing, heating, roofing and building work.
items.mechanics.stackexchange.com_en_all: Answers on diagnosing and repairing cars, trucks and motorcycles.
items.bicycles.stackexchange.com_en_all: Answers on repairing and maintaining bicycles, the transport that needs no fuel.
items.woodworking.stackexchange.com_en_all: Answers on working wood: tools, joints, finishes and building furniture and structures.
items.electronics.stackexchange.com_en_all: Answers on electronics and electrical engineering: circuits, power supplies, batteries, radios and repairing boards.
items.ham.stackexchange.com_en_all: Answers on amateur radio: equipment, antennas and licensing for communicating when phone networks are down.
items.lifehacks.stackexchange.com_en_all: Answers on solving everyday problems with simple tricks and what is at hand.
items.cooking.stackexchange.com_en_all: Answers from cooks on technique, food safety, substitutions and storage.
items.based.cooking_en_all: A small collection of plain home recipes without the clutter of recipe websites.
items.foss.cooking_en_all: Freely licensed recipes: simple, quick dishes written to be cooked.
items.gardening.stackexchange.com_en_all: Answers from gardeners on growing vegetables and fruit, soil, pests and plant disease.
items.homebrew.stackexchange.com_en_all: Answers on brewing beer, wine, cider and mead at home.
items.pets.stackexchange.com_en_all: Answers on the health, feeding and care of pets and small animals.
items.ted_mul_gardening: TED talks on gardening and growing food.
items.ted_mul_food: TED talks on food: where it comes from, nutrition and feeding people.
items.ted_mul_sustainability: TED talks on sustainability: energy, climate, resources and living within them.
items.phet_en_all: Interactive science and maths simulations from the University of Colorado: learning by doing, for school-age students.
items.libretexts.org_en_k12: Textbooks for school children from kindergarten to year 12.
items.vikidia_en_all_maxi: Vikidia, an encyclopedia written for children aged 8 to 13.
items.freecodecamp_en_all: freeCodeCamp's programming curriculum: web development, JavaScript and Python lessons with exercises.
items.libretexts.org_en_math: University and college mathematics textbooks, from algebra to calculus and beyond.
items.wikibooks_en_all_maxi: Wikibooks: open textbooks and manuals on languages, sciences, computing, cooking and practical skills.
items.khanacademy_en_all: Khan Academy's video lessons and practice exercises for maths, science and history, from primary school through to university entry: a whole school curriculum.
items.crashcourse_en_all: CrashCourse video series: fast, clear courses in history, science, literature, economics and more.
items.ted_mul_education: TED talks on education: how people learn and how to teach.
items.wikiversity_en_all_maxi: Wikiversity: open courses, tutorials and learning materials.
items.wikipedia_en_chemistry_maxi: Wikipedia's chemistry articles with pictures and diagrams.
items.wikipedia_en_physics_maxi: Wikipedia's physics articles with pictures and diagrams.
items.wikipedia_en_mathematics_maxi: Wikipedia's mathematics articles with pictures and diagrams.
items.physics.stackexchange.com_en_all: Physics questions answered by researchers and students.
items.chemistry.stackexchange.com_en_all: Chemistry questions answered by chemists, teachers and students, including practical and safety questions.
items.biology.stackexchange.com_en_all: Biology questions answered by researchers and students.
items.earthscience.stackexchange.com_en_all: Answers on geology, weather, climate and the oceans.
items.math.stackexchange.com_en_all: Mathematics questions at every level, answered step by step.
items.ted_mul_science: TED talks on science across every field.
items.unix.stackexchange.com_en_all: Answers on running and fixing Linux and other Unix-like systems, the kind of computer an Outpost may itself run on.
items.devdocs_en_python: The Python language and standard library reference.
items.raspberrypi.stackexchange.com_en_all: Answers on setting up and using Raspberry Pi boards, the cheapest low-power computers.
items.askubuntu.com_en_all: Answers on using and fixing Ubuntu Linux.
items.superuser.com_en_all: Answers on everyday computer problems on Windows, macOS and Linux: hardware, networks and software.
items.wiktionary_en-simple_all_nopic: A dictionary in simple English: definitions anyone can read, including learners.
items.wikivoyage_en_all_nopic: Wikivoyage travel guides, text only: what is where, how to get around and where to find water, food and shelter in places worldwide.
items.wikiquote_en_all_nopic: Wikiquote, text only: sourced quotations from people, books and films.
items.wiktionary_en_all_nopic: The full English Wiktionary: meanings, pronunciation and translations of words from most of the world's languages.
items.wikivoyage_en_all_maxi: Wikivoyage travel guides with maps and pictures.
items.wikiquote_en_all_maxi: Wikiquote with pictures: sourced quotations from people, books and films.
items.wikisource_en_all_nopic: Wikisource: the full text of public-domain books, laws, speeches and historical documents.

items.gutenberg_en_lcc-t: Project Gutenberg's technology shelf: engineering, building, metalwork, chemistry, manufacturing and home economics from before electronics.
items.gutenberg_en_lcc-r: Project Gutenberg's medicine shelf: older textbooks of medicine, surgery, nursing and pharmacy.
items.gutenberg_en_lcc-q: Project Gutenberg's science shelf: mathematics, astronomy, physics, chemistry, geology and natural history.
items.gutenberg_en_all: All of Project Gutenberg in English: more than 70,000 public-domain books, from novels to farming manuals.
